pullRequests.head: fix/active-distance-logic
pullRequests.body:
Before: Active distance (Match) widened the game's drawn flag (+0x31) to the Draw distance. So the game ran differently from the console (Aranos' hatch broke the launch camera), and rac2 needed an exception list.
After: +0x31 always uses the console's distance, in rac1 and rac2. The exception list is gone. At Match, far mobys the game leaves asleep…

commits.headline: fix(hostgen): fail the assembly guard only on translations code reaches (#536)
commits.author: Veradictus
commits.body:
#532's guard failed every function translated from the disc's assembly,
reached or not. A build without the disc translates nothing, so CI never
saw it, but rac1's disc builds translate 260 functions in PAL alone that
no translated code reaches, and each one stopped the build. Those stay
listed in the report's assembly_reached; only a translation with a
translated caller fails, as a stub with one does without the disc.

commits.headline: fix(renderer): refill one texture for rac2 movie frames (#543)
commits.author: nickyyOO
commits.body:
Since the rac2 movie overlay (#532), each movie frame went through the
generic GS upload path: hash 1 MB, convert it, check texture packs and
make a new GL texture. The pool kept up to 120 such frames (about
120 MB in RAM and as much on the GPU).

A picture now has one texture per block. Each frame copies the RGBA
rows into it and refills the GL texture in place with glTexSubImage2D,
as rac1's movie path does with its one picture texture. The texture
stays until the movie ends (forget_picture).
